top_signals.title: Tapestry CEO on Earnings Beat, Consumer Outlook
top_signals.summary: Tapestry shares rose about 6% after the company beat earnings expectations and raised its guidance. CEO Joanne Crevoiserat says that strong performance across North America, Asia—with China as an anchor—and Europe supported the higher outlook. She described the latest quarter as another strong period following a robust prior year, and said Tapestry’s growth capabilities are helping build durable momentum. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Carney, Bank of Canada Renew Framework to Focus on 2% Inflation Target
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Canada has renewed its policy framework, narrowing its focus on price stability and confirming that hitting its 2% inflation target is its most important priority.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Shield AI to acquire radar maker Echodyne to bust drones
top_signals.summary: Shield AI's CEO said the purchase of Echodyne supports the company’s aim to branch into different areas of unmanned systems.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
